svg.aria-label: FastPatch: patch night, on autopilot. Self-healing Windows patch remediation for Kaseya VSA fleets. 600+ machines patched at 99% success. Detect, diagnose, classify, remediate, verify, report. Never forces a reboot, never rewrites update policy. macOS support is next.
